description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for displaying saved news articles, allowing users to view and delete them. It utilizes provider for state management, and handles navigation to a detailed read screen.

classes.name: SavedNewsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a list of saved news articles and provides functionality to view or delete them.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the saved news screen, displaying either a message when no articles are saved or a list of saved articles.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the read article screen to show the selected news article.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to delete a news article, and if confirmed, deletes the article from the saved list and shows a snackbar notification.
